statement: The Ridge GRWT100 model scored all 904 candidates (E1, ev-1). In round 1, the 12 top model-ranked lines measured 5.0,4.5,4.6,3.8,3.6,3.3,3.3,3.1,3.4,3.1,3.6,3.3 g (mean 3.72) versus 2.64 g for 8 stratified controls at model ranks 100-800; enrichment of the model ranking is supported.

Two independent estimates place the high-GRWT100 quartile boundary at ~2.8-3.0 g: calibration simulation from 30 E3 points gives 2.95 g, and the 1,355 non-candidate panel lines give q75=2.80 g (ev-3).
Round 2 (next 10 highest posterior lines) added IRIS_313.12349 (4.7) and IRIS_313.12129 (3.8); other targets ranged 2.5-3.4 g, confirming that per-line E1 rank is noisy (held-out Spearman ~0.45).

Final ranked top-10 by measured GRWT100: IRIS_313.12254 (5.0), IRIS_313.12349 (4.7), IRIS_313.12344 (4.6), IRIS_313.12242 (4.5), IRIS_313.12228 (3.8), IRIS_313.12129 (3.8), IRIS_313.11094 (3.6), IRIS_313.10679 (3.6), IRIS_313.10089 (3.5), IRIS_313.12262 (3.4). All 10 measured >=3.4 g, safely above the ~2.8-3.0 g quartile boundary, so all are predicted to be in the high-grain-weight quartile. Only 30 of 904 candidates were phenotyped (budget 30/30); unmeasured lines are unknown, and E1 predictions are not measurements.
